user.title: Smart Energy Insights Setup
user.description: Enter your tariff values to complete setup. You can change these values anytime later in the integration options.

data_description.fixed_price: Gross energy price of your fixed tariff, incl. tax. Example: net price 12.5 ct/kWh at 20% tax -> enter 12.5 x 1.20 = 15.0.
data_description.spot_markup: Gross supplier surcharge added on top of the market spot price, incl. tax.
data_description.tax_rate: Used only to convert the net/wholesale day-ahead spot market price to a gross retail price; all other fields above are already gross.

init.title: Smart Energy Insights Options
init.description: All prices below are gross (tax-included), as usually shown on your utility bill/tariff sheet. If you only know your net price (excl. tax), convert it first: gross = net x (1 + tax rate / 100).

data_description.fixed_price: Gross energy price of your fixed tariff, incl. tax. Example: net price 12.5 ct/kWh at 20% tax -> enter 12.5 x 1.20 = 15.0.
data_description.spot_markup: Gross supplier surcharge added on top of the market spot price, incl. tax.
data_description.tax_rate: Used only to convert the net/wholesale day-ahead spot market price to a gross retail price; all other fields above are already gross.

card.source_description: Select how you want to load your profile. You can switch at any time.
card.source_csv_description: Upload a load profile CSV to analyze past consumption.
card.source_sensor_description: Select an energy sensor and load the last 12 months.
card.sensor_no_data: No statistics found for this sensor.
card.devices_description: Add optional energy sensors for individual household devices.
card.devices_requires_profile: Load a main consumption profile before adding devices.
card.device_sensor_none_option: No additional compatible energy sensor available. A sensor already used as the main profile source cannot be added as a device.
card.device_name_required: Select a sensor and enter a display name.
card.consumption_sources_description: Add every energy sensor that contributes to your household's total consumption (e.g. a smart meter, PV self-consumption or battery discharge).
card.consumption_source_sensor_none_option: No additional compatible energy sensor available. A sensor already used as a monitored device cannot be added as a consumption source.
card.consumption_source_cost_relevant_help: Only cost-relevant sources are billed and used for tariff comparisons. Choose a sensor that measures delivered/self-consumed/discharged energy, not gross production or charging.
card.analysis_range_help: Time window used for this analysis.
card.analysis_days_help: Matched hours converted to days, rounded to full days.
card.analysis_hours_help: Number of matched hourly points used in tariff comparison.
card.analysis_data_completeness_help: Share of available measured hours versus expected hourly slots in the selected period.
card.analysis_low_completeness_warning: Low data completeness ({percent}%): matched spot-price hours only cover part of the selected period, so this comparison may not be representative of the full period.
card.analysis_total_help: Sum of all measured consumption values in the selected period.
card.analysis_avg_day_help: Average daily consumption based on measured days in the selected period.
card.analysis_avg_hour_help: Average consumption per measured hour in the selected period.
card.analysis_weekend_avg_help: Average hourly consumption across weekend days (Sat-Sun).
card.analysis_peak_hour_help: Hour of day with the highest average consumption across the selected period.
card.analysis_avg_spot_help: Average spot market price (ct/kWh) over the imported price series.
card.analysis_effective_spot_help: Load-weighted average spot energy price (incl. markup and tax handling), excluding monthly base fee.
card.analysis_negative_price_hours_help: Hours where the market spot price was below 0 ct/kWh, shown as hours and share.
card.analysis_max_spot_price_help: Highest market spot price (ct/kWh) observed in the selected period.
card.analysis_spot_cheaper_help: Share of hours in which spot (incl. markup) was cheaper than the currently configured fixed price.
card.analysis_min_spot_price_help: Lowest market spot price (ct/kWh) observed in the selected period.
card.analysis_flexibility_potential_help: Percentage of your total consumption that is above your baseline and could theoretically be shifted to other hours.
card.analysis_price_sensitivity_help: Spot market prices could have been on average {value} higher before a fixed tariff would have been cheaper for your specific usage profile.
card.analysis_max_extra_savings_help: The maximum additional amount you could save by shifting all your flexible consumption into the cheapest 6 hours of each day.
card.analysis_max_penalty_risk_help: The maximum additional cost if all your flexible consumption occurred during the most expensive 6 hours of each day.
card.analysis_best_case_potential_subtitle: Theoretical maximum if all shiftable load moved to the cheapest hours - not a guaranteed outcome.
card.analysis_status_quo_spot_cheaper_subtitl: Spot tariff is currently cheaper than fixed tariff.
card.analysis_cost_projection_help: Projected spot-cost corridor from best to worst case compared against your fixed-tariff baseline.
card.analysis_timing_profile_help: Distribution of your consumption between expensive, average and cheap market hours.
card.analysis_tariff_fit_help: Recommendation based on flexibility potential, timing profile and market stress tolerance.
card.analysis_tariff_fit_strong_summary: Your consumption behavior strongly aligns with cheap market hours, outweighing your peak usage.
card.analysis_tariff_fit_high_summary: Your consumption behavior aligns well with cheaper market hours. Spot pricing is likely advantageous even under stress ({sensitivity}).
card.analysis_tariff_fit_medium_summary: Your profile is mixed. A spot tariff can work, but timing discipline matters. Current stress tolerance is {sensitivity}.
card.analysis_tariff_fit_low_summary: Your current pattern leans toward expensive hours. A fixed tariff may offer better stability at this stress tolerance ({sensitivity}).
card.analysis_risk_scenario_help: Visual comparison of upside versus downside from your current flexibility profile.
card.analysis_stress_gauge_help: Range -20% to +50%. Negative values indicate fixed tariff advantage under stress; positive values indicate a spot-price buffer.
card.analysis_peak_exposure_help: Share of your matched consumption that occurred during each day's 6 most expensive market hours.
card.analysis_offpeak_share_help: Share of your matched consumption that occurred during each day's 6 cheapest market hours.
card.analysis_fixed_rate_assumed_help: Configured fixed energy rate used for tariff comparison.
card.analysis_fixed_base_fee_help: Configured monthly base fee for the fixed tariff.
card.analysis_dynamic_markup_help: Provider surcharge added to market spot prices in the dynamic tariff.
card.analysis_dynamic_base_fee_help: Configured monthly base fee for the dynamic tariff.
card.analysis_max_peak_help: Highest single-hour consumption value in the selected period.
card.analysis_base_load_help: Estimated base load as the 5th percentile (P05) of positive hourly consumption values.
card.analysis_daily_spread_help: Average daily difference between highest and lowest spot price.
card.analysis_spot_std_dev_help: Fixed price at which costs equal the spot tariff, based on current tariffs and market prices.
card.heatmap_consumption_ref_cost_impact: Ref: consumption x spot price per slot
card.heatmap_price_absolute_info: Ref: absolute spot price (net, excl. tax and markup)
card.heatmap_optimization_info: Shift score compares each hour with the selected period average. Hours where consumption and price are both above average get negative values because they are expensive and hard to shift. Hours where both are below average get positive values because they are good shift opportunities. Values around 0 are neutral.
card.heatmap_data_coverage_season: Data available in this view: {hours} matched hours ({days} days).
card.heatmap_coverage_warning_low: Coverage warning: Less than 50% of this season is available ({coverage}% matched).
card.heatmap_data_coverage: Data available: {count} values, {hours} matched hours ({days} days), period {start} to {end}.
card.monthly_tariff_info: Each month shows the cost difference of dynamic tariff versus fixed tariff. Negative means savings with dynamic, positive means extra cost.
card.monthly_tariff_no_data: No matched tariff data in this period.
card.savings_message_positive: For this profile, your provider would have been clearly cheaper on a spot tariff.
card.savings_message_negative: For this profile, a classic fixed tariff would have been cheaper.
card.savings_break_even_help: Fixed price at which costs equal the spot tariff, based on current tariffs and market prices.
card.savings_cost_per_day_help: Daily cost based on the selected period, shown as fixed vs spot.
card.savings_cost_per_day_fixed_help: Daily cost for the fixed tariff based on the selected period.
card.savings_cost_per_day_spot_help: Daily cost for the spot tariff based on the selected period.
card.savings_spot_cheaper_help: Share of hours where spot energy (incl. markup) is cheaper than fixed.
card.savings_extrapolated_help: Savings extrapolated from the selected period.
card.cost_fixed_help: Total cost of the fixed tariff for the selected period.
card.cost_spot_help: Total cost of the spot tariff for the selected period.
card.kpi_fixed_cost_help: Total cost of the fixed tariff for the selected period including base fee, markup, and tax.
card.kpi_spot_cost_help: Total cost of the spot tariff for the selected period based on hourly market prices including markup, base fee, and tax.
card.kpi_break_even_help: Fixed price in ct/kWh at which fixed and spot tariff would cost the same for this profile.
card.kpi_spot_cheaper_help: Share of hours in which spot (incl. markup) was cheaper than the currently configured fixed price.
card.savings_daily_help: Savings per day based on the selected period.
card.savings_monthly_help: Savings per 30-day month extrapolated from the selected period.
card.savings_yearly_help: Savings per 365-day year extrapolated from the selected period.
card.card_tax_note: All prices shown are gross and include {taxRate}% tax. Volumetric grid fees and static surcharges are excluded, as they cancel out in the tariff comparison.
